name: Dare ni Demo Ura ga Aru -True or Lie?-
original_name: 誰にでも裏がある－True or Lie？－
source:
Nanako and Momoe are sisters. They keep a good relationship though they have totally different characters. One day, Momoe starts working at Nanako's school as a teacher. They meet six male students there, but they all look tricky. As time passes, they, however, get attracted to them little by little....

[From ErogeShop]
